messages:
nina.kapoor: Cardea APAC asked for a focused 75-min lab on VPC peering + private deployment patterns. Theyre available late-afternoon PT. Need to pick a date and confirm facilitators. Proposed: 2026-06-02 16:30 PT or 2026-06-04 17:00 PT. React :one:/:two:.

leon.ng: :one: for me. I can lead the peering walkthrough and provide a tiny terraform template.

rachel.benoit: Ill handle invites + pre-req checklist. Can we require a test VPC and one engineer with privileged access? Also prepping a one-page rollback runbook.

sam.khan: Prefer :two: if possible (helps our EMEA folks). I can cover KMS/HSM integration and key rotation notes for private deployments.

infra-bot: Draft invite created: https://calendar.redwood.com/e/APAC-Peering-Lab (status: tentative)

nina.kapoor: Good notes. Action items: Leon -> terraform module + demo steps; Sam -> KMS slide + short CLI snippets; Rachel -> send invite + feedback form. We should include a 10-min "confidence poll" at the end (Likert 1-5).

leon.ng: Adding a demo snippet in the doc now:
```
terraform apply -var='env=cardea-test' -auto-approve
redwoodctl peer create --vpc vpc-1234 --peer vpc-5678
```

rachel.benoit: Cardea confirmed :two: (2026-06-04 17:00 PT). They will bring 3 infra engineers + security. Locking slot and sending pre-reqs by EOD tomorrow.

nina.kapoor: Thanks team. Marking renewal at "monitor" with follow-up two weeks after workshop. Closing thread once invite is sent. :white_check_mark:
notes: enablement scheduling; VPC peering lab; pre-req checklist; rollback runbook; renewal monitoring
